capabilities: Schedule recurring note reviews with global, folder-specific, and per-note intervals
Mark notes as reviewed, writing today's date to frontmatter
Open a random due note via command, ribbon button, or status-bar due counter
Show the active note's review status and vault-wide due count in the status bar
Include or exclude folders from review scope
disambiguation: Not a flashcard spaced-repetition tool; it resurfaces whole ordinary notes on a schedule.
extras: Formerly named Review Simple; settings, review dates, and hotkeys carry over with no migration. Unreleased master builds can be installed via BRAT (CitrusRenegade/review-anew-obsidian).
intentEvidence: There are several Obsidian plugins and workflows for revisiting notes with their own trade-offs.
motivation: The author was inspired by the "Reviewed by ... on ..." field on WebMD.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring notes back for periodic rereading, and existing review plugins require Dataview or a flashcard-first workflow.

relations.evidence: A close alternative for reviewing notes with frontmatter-driven schedules.
The closest conceptual alternative: it focuses on reviewing, resurfacing, and repeating ordinary notes.
A mature spaced repetition plugin with a strong flashcards-first workflow.
Implements a more opinionated workflow around spaced repetition for writing and incremental note development.
Not a revisit notes workflow, just quick adds the current note to a future daily note

summary: Spaced note-review scheduler that resurfaces notes on recurring intervals, storing last-review dates in each note's frontmatter.
